protocol.name: Priority 1 Simple Baselines
protocol.scope: Smoke and timing plumbing only; no formal training or held-out error selection.

spline.axis: Q only, axis=0 of [Q,T,3]; never sparse lambda reconstruction
spline.formal_training_Q: All 1400 original training Q only; stable ascending sort and retain source row mapping; reject duplicates.
spline.fit: CubicSpline with bc_type=natural, float64 raw xyz, no smoothing/hyperparameter search.
spline.boundary_proposal: Inside hull: cubic spline. Outside: explicit linear tails from the first/last two training knots; report boundary subgroup and full-set metrics. Requires approval, not implemented in this smoke.
spline.smoke_boundary: extrapolate=False; reject out-of-hull queries before evaluation; intentionally verify rejection.
spline.grids: Native T1200 first. Separate T2399 fit on matched train truth as a proposed extension. Q-only spline does not define unseen lambda nodes; cross-resolution comparison is pending a separately declared lambda resampling rule, never implicit.
spline.leakage: Validation Q for selection only after protocol lock; no validation/test/independent-Q400 knots or refitted statistics; no test-driven interpolation/boundary choice.

mlp.proposal: Pointwise 2->576->576->576->576->3, GELU, no Fourier/positional encoding, no residual or physics inputs; independent of lambda length.
mlp.smoke: 2->16->16->3; one forward/backward, no optimizer step; seed27.
mlp.formal_training: Reuse train-only Track A standard normalization with float64 reductions over float32 samples. Raw targets, normalized MSE, trajectory batches32 with all lambda points per trajectory. Original train/val Q splits; never split randomly by coordinate points.
mlp.defaults: Proposed seed27, AdamW lr1e-3 weight_decay1e-4, ExponentialLR gamma0.995, 500 epochs maximum, minimum validation normalized MSE BEST over all epochs, preserve original batch32 eval and canonical order.
mlp.authorization: New baseline architecture and formal training protocol require approval; not added to the locked six-model Track A registry.

metrics.space: Raw physical xyz, float64 reductions, epsilon=1e-12
metrics.global: norm(pred-truth over all Q,lambda,xyz)/(norm(truth over all Q,lambda,xyz)+epsilon)
metrics.distinction: Global weights trajectories by truth energy in squared norms; mean-per-Q weights relative errors equally. Not interchangeable; neither is a mean of pointwise relative errors.

timing.solver: CPU perf_counter wall-clock for original simulate_one_orbit_second_order including initialization, RK4 loop, xyz conversion and diagnostics; exclude import/disk writes. One Q at a time; serial batch32 total if later approved.
timing.neural: Separately CPU/GPU resident-tensor model-only latency and end-to-end Q/grid construction+normalization+H2D+forward+D2H+inverse normalization. synchronize CUDA before start and before stop. Exclude model load/disk writes; report raw repetitions and median.
timing.comparison: Require identical Q/grid/output contract for numerical task equivalence. Solver float64 and neural float32, CPU vs GPU and unlike implementation paths preclude a pure algorithmic speedup claim. Do not report a formal speedup from smoke timings.
timing.precision: Record actual TF32, matmul, cuDNN, threads, CUDA runtime, device and HAMI stderr; do not change settings.

solver.scope: initialization + RK4 + xyz + diagnostics; excludes imports and disk IO
